target_customer: Pharma, biotech, CRO and CDMO, testing and research labs, universities and public health labs in China and abroad
problem: Lab management depended too heavily on people, and labs lacked real-time monitoring and audit-ready records of equipment and sample conditions.
business_model: SaaS lab management software plus IoT hardware and monitoring services
product_category: Lab operations software and AIoT monitoring

founders.name: Kenny Li
founders.background_notes: YC page lists Agilent and Thermo Fisher; 36Kr says he saw the pain of manual lab management while at Thermo Fisher.

founders.name: Liyang Zhang
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as co-founder of iLabService and CEO of SciOne AI; 36Kr 2021 lists a Chief Product Officer with the same Chinese name rendering and consulting background.

founders.name: Ge Xu
founders.background_notes: Named CTO in 36Kr July 2021; not named on the YC page, so founder status is unconfirmed.

technical_complexity.rationale: Combining custom IoT sensors, cloud software and lab compliance workflows is standard engineering with hardware integration and regulated data requirements.

defensibility.rationale: Deployed sensors, compliance records and customer integrations raise switching costs. The 36Kr article cites 90 percent renewal in 2020.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Thermo Fisher became a channel partner: the company site cites a white-label freezer monitoring service for Thermo Fisher's LabServ sub-brand.

market_need_then: Regulated labs needed monitoring of freezers and environment and audit evidence. 36Kr in 2021 reported over 100 customers and 120 percent amount renewal, but no 2018 demand figures were found.

branding.domain_note: Currently ilabservice.ai; earlier domain not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Technical and compliance focused: 'Turn lab signals into audit-ready operating evidence'

brand_strength.rationale: Chinese name 释普科技 and English iLabService; no press on the brand itself. Value comes from customer logos rather than the name.

pivots.to: AIoT LabOps infrastructure for regulated labs
pivots.why: Current site frames the focus on audit-ready evidence for the AI for Science era; timing not stated

outcome_analysis: iLabService, founded by former Thermo Fisher and Agilent staff, took a YC seed in 2018 and angel money in 2019, then closed a pre-A and an A round of nearly 100 million RMB in 2021 led by Gobi Partners China. It claims 200 plus deployments and a Thermo Fisher white-label channel. Amounts in USD are unverified, so the funding history is only partial.
notes: 36Kr reports the Series A as nearly 100 million RMB led by 经纬中国 (Gobi Partners China; the English name is my rendering). Preqin snippets said Matrix Partners China led and CB Insights says 15.36M USD on 2021-07-27; investor names conflict between sources. 36Kr metadata also shows 2022-04. Pre-A is recorded as other because the article gives no amount. Competitors named by 36Kr (biosafety equipment makers) come from a 2021 article, so none are listed for 2018. A 2018 competitor search found no lab IoT peers. Founding year 2016 per CB Insights, January 2017 per 36Kr.
